summary: Build AI adoption plans, reduce resistance, and track uptake with practical change tools. Enrol in TrainingCred’s 5-day course.
lede: AI Change Management and Adoption Strategy helps professionals plan, lead, and measure the human and operational shift required for AI-enabled work. Build the ability to assess readiness, map affected roles, shape stakeholder commitments, and track whether people adopt new workflows. Using practical frameworks informed by ADKAR and Kotter’s 8-Step Process, the course guides you through change impact assessments, engagement maps, communication plans, adoption scorecards, and reinforcement plans. You will also explore responsible AI considerations, change fatigue management, feedback loops, and metrics that support sustained use, trust, and momentum.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are responsible for making AI adoption workable in real organizations, where adoption, trust, and role redesign must happen together.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of organizational change, projects, or business operations; no programming is required. You should be comfortable reviewing process maps, stakeholder registers, and basic adoption metrics, and you should bring one AI-related change initiative, pilot, or workflow from your own organization for class exercises. Prior experience with ADKAR, Kotter’s 8-Step Process, or change impact assessments is helpful but not mandatory. Advanced concepts such as responsible AI governance and adoption analytics are taught at an operational application level, not as technical engineering.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
